entities.summary: ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Jurayj al-Rūmī al-Umawī al-Qurashī al-Makkī commonly known as Ibn Jurayj was an eighth-century tabi'i faqīh, exegete and transmitter of hadith.
